name: jev-memory
description: Remembers the preferences you state in prompts: Jev (via treg) judges each prompt's sentences after the turn and saves lasting ones to .claude/jev-memory.md.

tregPath.title: treg binary
tregPath.description: Path to the treg CLI. Leave empty to use $HOME/.local/bin/treg.

takeOverMemory.title: Replace Claude Code's own memory
takeOverMemory.description: Drop Claude Code's built-in memory instructions so preferences are saved only by jev-memory.

playSound.title: Coin sound
playSound.description: Play a short coin sound when a preference is saved.
